arxiv-2103-09532.title: CoMP-Enabled RAN Slicing for Tactile Internet
arxiv-2103-09532.creator: Peng Yang, Xing Xi, Tony Q. S. Quek, Hyundong Shin
arxiv-2103-09532.description: Abstract Tactile Internet (TI) enables the omnipresence and exchange of tactile experiences across the globe via the ultra-reliable and ultra-responsive connectivity. This article argues for coordinated multi-point (CoMP) enabled radio access network (RAN) slicing as an efficient solution that satisfies the stringent reliable and responsive connectivity requirements for supporting tactile applications.

arxiv-2109-07954.title: Improving Unsupervised Question Answering via Summarization-Informed Question Generation
arxiv-2109-07954.creator: Chenyang Lyu Lifeng Shang Yvette Graham Jennifer Foster, Xin Jiang Qun Liu
arxiv-2109-07954.description: Abstract Question Generation (QG) is the task of generating a plausible question for a given <passage, answer> pair. Template-based QG uses linguistically-informed heuristics to transform declarative sentences into interrogatives, whereas supervised QG uses existing Question Answering (QA) datasets to train a system to generate a question given a passage and an answer.

arxiv-2204-13104.title: Kitaev Chain with a Fractional Twist
arxiv-2204-13104.creator: Bora Basa 1 , Gabriele La Nave 2 , and Philip W. Phillips 1
arxiv-2204-13104.description: Abstract The topological non-triviality of insulating phases of matter are by now well understood through topological K-theory where the indices of the Dirac operators are assembled into topological classes. We consider in the context of the Kitaev chain a notion of a generalized Dirac operator where the associated Clifford algebra is centrally extended.

arxiv-2207-14511.title: Near-IR and Visual High Resolution Polarimetric Imaging with AO Systems Volume: 360 Journal: Astronomical Polarimetry 2020: New Era of Multiwavelength Polarimetry
arxiv-2207-14511.creator: Hans M. Schmid
arxiv-2207-14511.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hans M. Schmid. Many spectacular polarimetric images have been obtained in recent years with adaptive optics (AO) instruments at large telescopes because they profit significantly from the high spatial resolution. This paper summarizes some basic principles for AO polarimetry, discusses challenges and limitations of these systems, and describes results which illustrate the performance of AO polarimeters for the investigation of circumstellar disks, of dusty winds from evolved stars, and for the search of reflecting extra-solar planets.

arxiv-2209-11727.title: Boost CTR Prediction for New Advertisements via Modeling Visual Content
arxiv-2209-11727.creator: Tan Yu, Zhipeng Jin, Jie Liu, Yi Yang, Hongliang Fei, Ping Li
arxiv-2209-11727.description: Abstract Existing advertisements click-through rate (CTR) prediction models are mainly dependent on behavior ID features, which are learned based on the historical user-ad interactions. Nevertheless, behavior ID features relying on historical user behaviors are not feasible to describe new ads without previous interactions with users.

arxiv-2210-05346.title: Stateful realizers for nonstandard analysis Thanks: The authors would like to thank Alexandre Miquel for suggesting several ideas at the root of this work and Valentin Blot and Mikhail Katz, as well as the anonymous reviewers of [ DM21 ] , for their accurate remarks and suggestions. The first author
arxiv-2210-05346.creator: Bruno Dinis ORCID:0000-0003-2143-3289, Étienne Miquey ORCID:0000-0002-5987-6547
arxiv-2210-05346.description: Abstract . In this paper we propose a new approach to realizability interpretations for nonstandard arithmetic. We deal with nonstandard analysis in the context of (semi) intuitionistic realizability, focusing on the Lightstone-Robinson construction of a model for nonstandard analysis through an ultrapower.

arxiv-2309-10570.title: Unifying inflationary and reheating solution
arxiv-2309-10570.creator: Manjeet Kaur, Debottam Nandi, Sharath Raghavan B
arxiv-2309-10570.description: Abstract The conventional background solution for the evolution of a single canonical inflaton field performs admirably in extreme scenarios such as the slow-roll phase (where the slow-roll parameter is much less than one) and the deep reheating era (where the Hubble parameter is much smaller than the effective mass of the potential and the field oscillates around the minimum of

arxiv-2310-06698.title: Simulating the Transverse Field Ising Model on the Kagome Lattice using a Programmable Quantum Annealer
arxiv-2310-06698.creator: Pratyankara Narasimhan, Stephan Humeniuk, Ananda Roy, Victor Drouin-Touchette
arxiv-2310-06698.description: Abstract The presence of competing interactions due to geometry leads to frustration in quantum spin models. As a consequence, the ground state of such systems often displays a large degeneracy that can be lifted due to thermal or quantum effects. One such example is the antiferromagnetic Ising model on the Kagome lattice.

arxiv-2407-20833.title: Approximating electromagnetic fields in discontinuous media using a single physics-informed neural network
arxiv-2407-20833.creator: Michel Nohra, Steven Dufour
arxiv-2407-20833.description: Abstract Keywords: PINN, Electromagnetism, Maxwell, Parametric PINN Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a new family of numerical methods, based on deep learning, for modeling boundary value problems. They offer an advantage over traditional numerical methods for high-dimensional, parametric, and data-driven problems. However, they perform poorly on problems where the solution exhibits high frequencies, such as discontinuities or sharp gradients.

arxiv-2411-14628.title: HotSpot: Signed Distance Function Optimization with an Asymptotically Sufficient Condition
arxiv-2411-14628.creator: Zimo Wang, Cheng Wang, Taiki Yoshino, Sirui Tao, Ziyang Fu, Tzu-Mao Li
arxiv-2411-14628.description: Abstract We propose a method, HotSpot , for optimizing neural signed distance functions. Existing losses, such as the eikonal loss, act as necessary but insufficient constraints and cannot guarantee that the recovered implicit function represents a true distance function, even if the output minimizes these losses almost everywhere. Furthermore, the eikonal loss suffers from stability issues in optimization.

arxiv-2412-09290.title: Asymptotics of Harish-Chandra transform and infinitesimal freeness
arxiv-2412-09290.creator: Alexey Bufetov, Panagiotis Zografos Leipzig University, Institute of Mathematics
arxiv-2412-09290.description: Abstract In the last ten years a technique of Schur generating functions and Harish-Chandra transforms was developed for the study of the asymptotic behavior of discrete particle systems and random matrices. In the current paper we extend this toolbox in several directions.

arxiv-2501-03419.title: Rapidity asymmetry of jet-hadron correlation as a robust signal of diffusion wake induced by di-jets in high-energy heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2501-03419.creator: Zhong Yang, Xin-Nian Wang
arxiv-2501-03419.description: Abstract Diffusion wake accompanying a Mach cone is a unique feature of the medium response to jet-medium interaction inside the quark-gluon plasma in high-energy heavy-ion collisions. It leads to a depletion of soft hadrons in the opposite direction of the propagating jet and has been recently observed in Z Z -jet events of Pb+Pb collisions at LHC.

arxiv-2506-14755.title: Optimizing Length Compression in Large Reasoning Models
arxiv-2506-14755.creator: Zhengxiang Cheng, Dongping Chen, Mingyang Fu, Tianyi Zhou
arxiv-2506-14755.description: Abstract Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success, yet they often suffer from producing unnecessary and verbose reasoning chains. We identify a core aspect of this issue as “invalid thinking” — models tend to repeatedly double-check their work after having derived the correct answer.

pmc-10671805.title: Role of the p38/AKT Pathway in the Promotion of Cell Proliferation by Serum Heat Inactivation
pmc-10671805.creator: Huijun Geng, Rongnuo Li, Dingping Feng, Yuanyuan Zhu, Lu Deng, Alfonso Baldi
pmc-10671805.description: Serum is a common biomaterial in cell culture that provides nutrients and essential growth factors for cell growth. Serum heat inactivation is a common treatment method whose main purpose is to remove complement factors and viruses. As serum contains many heat-labile factors, heat inactivation may affect cell proliferation, migration, differentiation, and other functions.

pmc-11464527.title: The role of the S100A8/S100A9 in gastric tumor progression
pmc-11464527.creator: Shuangshuang Fang, Sijing Du, Xiaoying Luo, Xiangli Qing, Lin Wang, Yanran Ban, Gengqing Song, Yang Yang, Wei Wei
pmc-11464527.description: Gastric premalignant lesions can develop into cancer through multiple steps and inflammation plays a critical role. The aim of this study is to uncover the characteristics of macrophages and their gene expression in premalignant gastric lesions to identify novel biomarkers and potential targets for treatment. We used the computational algorithm CIBERSORT to estimate immune cell subsets present in gastric tissue.

pmc-12542897.title: Influence of polyethylene glycol on the mucus penetration and stability of lipid nanoparticles in cryopreservation and lyophilization
pmc-12542897.creator: Xueyan Wang, Yayi Zhao, Xingtao Huang, Yu Huang, Ye Zhang, Chenjie Xu
pmc-12542897.description: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have emerged as clinically validated drug delivery vehicles, as demonstrated by the successful deployment of COVID-19 mRNA vaccines (Comirnaty and Spikevax) and siRNA therpy (Patisiran). Building on these achievements, we investigated the functional roles of free polyethylene glycol (PEG) molecules in optimizing LNP performance.

pmc-12617744.title: HoloFoodR: a statistical programming framework for holo-omics data integration workflows
pmc-12617744.creator: Tuomas Borman, Artur Sannikov, Robert D Finn, Morten Tønsberg Limborg, Alexander B Rogers, Varsha Kale, Kati Hanhineva, Leo Lahti
pmc-12617744.description: SummaryHolo-omics is an emerging research area that integrates multi-omic datasets from the host organism and its microbiome to study their interactions. Recently, curated and openly accessible holo-omic databases have been developed. The HoloFood database, for instance, provides nearly 10 000 holo-omic profiles for salmon and chicken under controlled treatments.

pmc-13119070.title: Industrial Perspective on the Manufacturing of Lipid Nanoparticles for Nucleic Acid Delivery
pmc-13119070.creator: Jenny Hong Hoang, Melanie Ott, Eleni Samaridou, Moritz Beck-Broichsitter, Johanna Simon
pmc-13119070.description: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have emerged as a groundbreaking delivery platform, revolutionizing the development of nucleic acid-based medicines for gene delivery and gene therapy. This review provides an insightful industrial perspective on the production process of LNPs, focusing on cutting-edge manufacturing equipment, downstream processing and the crucial transition from laboratory to large scale.

pmc-13411428.title: Biomarkers and Early Mechanisms of Sarcopenia: Central Roles of Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Inflammaging, Cellular Senescence, and Neuromuscular Degeneration
pmc-13411428.creator: Hechmi Toumi, Ahmad Almhdie-Imjabbar, Nada Ibrahim, Eric Lespessailles
pmc-13411428.description: Sarcopenia is a progressive age-related skeletal muscle disorder characterized by the loss of muscle mass, strength, and physical performance, leading to frailty, disability, and increased mortality. Although its clinical consequences are well recognized, the underlying biological mechanisms remain incompletely understood, limiting the development of early diagnostic strategies and targeted therapies.

uslaw-usc-t25-s1680r.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s1680r.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 18 (Indian Health Care); Subchapter VI (Miscellaneous). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general Nothing in this chapter limits the ability of a tribal health program operating any health program, service, function, activity, or facility funded, in whole or part, by the Service through, or provided for in, a compact with the Service pursuant.
